companion_biscuit.name: Biscuit
companion_biscuit.bio: Loyal, loud, and convinced every stick is the best stick.

companion_brick.name: Brick
companion_brick.bio: Gentle giant knight. Cries at sunsets.

companion_ember_ash.name: Ember Ash
companion_ember_ash.bio: Fire-loving desert scout. Bad at whispering.

companion_gilly.name: Gilly
companion_gilly.bio: Cheerful swimmer. Thinks every puddle is an ocean.

companion_marigold.name: Marigold
companion_marigold.bio: Travelling cook. Feeds the party, judges your manners.

companion_professor_puffle.name: Professor Puffle
companion_professor_puffle.bio: Knows everything. Tells you, at length.

companion_scamp.name: Scamp
companion_scamp.bio: Steals things for you. And from you.

companion_sir_hops.name: Sir Hops
companion_sir_hops.bio: Very brave, very small, very sure of himself.

companion_sprocket_jr.name: Sprocket Jr.
companion_sprocket_jr.bio: Polite robot who apologises to doors.

companion_zed_9.name: Zed-9
companion_zed_9.bio: Alien navigator, collects Earth-like continent souvenirs.

hero_the_hoot.name: The Hoot
hero_the_hoot.bio: Paragon League. Power: night vision & flight.

lumen_apprentice.name: Lumen Apprentice
lumen_apprentice.bio: Lumen rank 2. Hilt built from carved wood.

lumen_elder.name: Lumen Elder
lumen_elder.bio: Lumen rank 5. Hilt built from temple brass.

lumen_guardian.name: Lumen Guardian
lumen_guardian.bio: Lumen rank 3. Hilt built from river stone.

lumen_initiate.name: Lumen Initiate
lumen_initiate.bio: Lumen rank 1. Hilt built from practice wood.

lumen_mentor_mentor_ember_eyes.name: Mentor Ember-Eyes
lumen_mentor_mentor_ember_eyes.bio: Teaches seeing in the dark. Wears sunglasses indoors.

lumen_mentor_mentor_hazelnut.name: Mentor Hazelnut
lumen_mentor_mentor_hazelnut.bio: Teaches speed. Never finishes a sentence.

lumen_mentor_mentor_old_tortoise.name: Mentor Old Tortoise
lumen_mentor_mentor_old_tortoise.bio: Teaches patience by being extremely slow.

lumen_warden.name: Lumen Warden
lumen_warden.bio: Lumen rank 4. Hilt built from old bone.

town_apex_chef_capello.name: Chef Capello
town_apex_chef_capello.bio: Rooftop diner owner. Serves "Villain Wings" (they are chicken).

town_apex_doris_dial.name: Doris Dial
town_apex_doris_dial.bio: Runs the Sidekick Agency. Has a waiting list of one: Zip.

town_apex_dot_dashwood.name: Dot Dashwood
town_apex_dot_dashwood.bio: Courier who is faster than most heroes, and annoyed about it.

town_apex_gus_gearbox.name: Gus Gearbox
town_apex_gus_gearbox.bio: Rooftop gardener who grows suspiciously large turnips.

town_apex_madame_seam.name: Madame Seam
town_apex_madame_seam.bio: Capeworks tailor. Refuses to make capes shorter than knees.

town_apex_mister_mopp.name: Mister Mopp
town_apex_mister_mopp.bio: Cleans up after hero fights. Has a loyalty card scheme.

town_apex_officer_plod.name: Officer Plod
town_apex_officer_plod.bio: Hands out parking tickets to flying heroes.

town_apex_penny_press.name: Penny Press
town_apex_penny_press.bio: Reporter. Has never once spotted the hero change clothes.

town_apex_unit_7.name: Unit 7
town_apex_unit_7.bio: Traffic robot. Counts cars. Loses count. Starts again.

town_brightharbour_benny_barnacle.name: Benny Barnacle
town_brightharbour_benny_barnacle.bio: Bakery apprentice, terrified of the oven.

town_brightharbour_bosun_bun.name: Bosun Bun
town_brightharbour_bosun_bun.bio: Ties knots nobody can untie, including himself.

town_brightharbour_captain_dribble.name: Captain Dribble
town_brightharbour_captain_dribble.bio: Retired harbour master. Still salutes seagulls.

town_brightharbour_gill.name: Gill
town_brightharbour_gill.bio: Has been "nearly finished" painting the lighthouse for 40 years.

town_brightharbour_lamp_keeper_lou.name: Lamp-Keeper Lou
town_brightharbour_lamp_keeper_lou.bio: Night watch. Mostly watches the moon.

town_brightharbour_mara_kettle.name: Mara Kettle
town_brightharbour_mara_kettle.bio: Bakes biscuits so salty the gulls queue for them.

town_brightharbour_nell_netley.name: Nell Netley
town_brightharbour_nell_netley.bio: Runs the Knot Just Rope shop. Laughs at her own sign daily.

town_brightharbour_old_gruff.name: Old Gruff
town_brightharbour_old_gruff.bio: A grumpy fisher-cat who has never once caught a fish.

town_brightharbour_pip_puddleby.name: Pip Puddleby
town_brightharbour_pip_puddleby.bio: A postal frog who delivers every letter to the wrong boat, cheerfully.

town_brightharbour_tilly_tackle.name: Tilly Tackle
town_brightharbour_tilly_tackle.bio: Sells rope, string, and "slightly used" rope.

town_ember_basil_burrows.name: Basil Burrows
town_ember_basil_burrows.bio: Grows the only lettuce in the desert. Very proud.

town_ember_cactus_kay.name: Cactus Kay
town_ember_cactus_kay.bio: Serves cactus cooler. Do not ask what is in it.

town_ember_ember.name: Ember
town_ember_ember.bio: Ruin explorer who collects shiny pebbles.

town_ember_lava_lou.name: Lava Lou
town_ember_lava_lou.bio: Cooks eggs on rocks. Hot Rocks Diner.

town_ember_mirage_mo.name: Mirage Mo
town_ember_mirage_mo.bio: Spice seller whose stall is sometimes not there.

town_ember_old_sol.name: Old Sol
town_ember_old_sol.bio: Sells sunhats and sun-umbrellas and sun-everything.

town_ember_saffron_sands.name: Saffron Sands
town_ember_saffron_sands.bio: Caravan leader. Has never once been on time.

town_ember_watcher_wren.name: Watcher Wren
town_ember_watcher_wren.bio: Lookout on the oasis tower. Shouts "SAND!" a lot.

town_frontier_bolt.name: Bolt
town_frontier_bolt.bio: Canteen robot. Serves soup in bubbles.

town_frontier_cadet_comet.name: Cadet Comet
town_frontier_cadet_comet.bio: Newest Star Legion cadet. Helmet on backwards.

town_frontier_commander_nova.name: Commander Nova
town_frontier_commander_nova.bio: Moon base commander. Hides snacks in zero-G.

town_frontier_dr_orbit.name: Dr. Orbit
town_frontier_dr_orbit.bio: Astronomer. Mostly looks at Earth-like continent and sighs.

town_frontier_flight_deck_fran.name: Flight Deck Fran
town_frontier_flight_deck_fran.bio: Launch controller. Counts down from very large numbers.

town_frontier_gloop.name: Gloop
town_frontier_gloop.bio: Pilot trainee. Hops in low gravity. Keeps floating off.

town_frontier_miner_mags.name: Miner Mags
town_frontier_miner_mags.bio: Asteroid miner with a very shiny pickaxe.

town_frontier_rover_rudy.name: Rover Rudy
town_frontier_rover_rudy.bio: Moon rover racer. Has crashed into the moon.

town_frontier_sprocket.name: Sprocket
town_frontier_sprocket.bio: Grows space lettuce in a dome.

town_frontier_zed.name: Zed
town_frontier_zed.bio: Friendly alien trader. Accepts pips and compliments.

town_kingsreach_baker_bunwell.name: Baker Bunwell
town_kingsreach_baker_bunwell.bio: Ye Olde Bread is not actually very old.

town_kingsreach_brother_bramble.name: Brother Bramble
town_kingsreach_brother_bramble.bio: Brews honey tea strong enough to wake a dragon.

town_kingsreach_farrier_flint.name: Farrier Flint
town_kingsreach_farrier_flint.bio: Shoes horses. Also shoes, for the horses who asked.

town_kingsreach_lady_thimble.name: Lady Thimble
town_kingsreach_lady_thimble.bio: Banner seamstress who sews tiny jokes into every flag.

town_kingsreach_moat_guide_mol.name: Moat Guide Mol
town_kingsreach_moat_guide_mol.bio: Runs moat tours. The moat is twelve studs long.

town_kingsreach_mother_hen.name: Mother Hen
town_kingsreach_mother_hen.bio: Keeps 200 chickens and knows all their names.

town_kingsreach_old_tom_turnip.name: Old Tom Turnip
town_kingsreach_old_tom_turnip.bio: Grows turnips, fears the turnip protest graffiti.

town_kingsreach_sir_wobble.name: Sir Wobble
town_kingsreach_sir_wobble.bio: A knight who is afraid of horses. Rides a very patient goat.

town_kingsreach_squire_sprout.name: Squire Sprout
town_kingsreach_squire_sprout.bio: Polishes armour so well it blinds the enemy. And himself.

town_mistpeak_brother_breeze.name: Brother Breeze
town_mistpeak_brother_breeze.bio: Rings the prayer bell at exactly the wrong time.

town_mistpeak_grandmaster_grumble.name: Grandmaster Grumble
town_mistpeak_grandmaster_grumble.bio: Very slow. Very strict. Very old.

town_mistpeak_kiko_kite.name: Kiko Kite
town_mistpeak_kiko_kite.bio: Kite flyer. Once flew away for a week.

town_mistpeak_lin_lantern.name: Lin Lantern
town_mistpeak_lin_lantern.bio: Lantern seller who is afraid of the dark.

town_mistpeak_master_pao.name: Master Pao
town_mistpeak_master_pao.bio: Balances on anything. Even this sentence.

town_mistpeak_mei_mist.name: Mei Mist
town_mistpeak_mei_mist.bio: Tea house owner. Every tea is "the good one".

town_mistpeak_pebble.name: Pebble
town_mistpeak_pebble.bio: Rice terrace farmer who naps in puddles.

town_mistpeak_scroll_keeper_sum.name: Scroll-Keeper Sum
town_mistpeak_scroll_keeper_sum.bio: Has read every scroll. Twice. Backwards.

town_mistpeak_sister_stillwater.name: Sister Stillwater
town_mistpeak_sister_stillwater.bio: Jade Blade instructor. Silent, except for snacks.

town_saltspray_admiral_adequate.name: Admiral Adequate
town_saltspray_admiral_adequate.bio: Has won exactly as many battles as he lost.

town_saltspray_barnaby_bilge.name: Barnaby Bilge
town_saltspray_barnaby_bilge.bio: Bilge pump operator. Unusually happy about it.

town_saltspray_cap_n_crumb.name: Cap'n Crumb
town_saltspray_cap_n_crumb.bio: Searching for treasure. It is in his pocket.

town_saltspray_coco_cove.name: Coco Cove
town_saltspray_coco_cove.bio: Coconut stall owner with a coconut-shaped hat.

town_saltspray_granny_gale.name: Granny Gale
town_saltspray_granny_gale.bio: Predicts weather by her knees. Is always right.

town_saltspray_mermaid_statue_steve.name: Mermaid Statue Steve
town_saltspray_mermaid_statue_steve.bio: Poses as a statue for tourists. Blinks.

town_saltspray_midshipman_muddle.name: Midshipman Muddle
town_saltspray_midshipman_muddle.bio: Navy cadet who keeps saluting the wrong way.

town_saltspray_rigger_rex.name: Rigger Rex
town_saltspray_rigger_rex.bio: Climbs masts faster than anyone, then gets stuck.

town_saltspray_shelly.name: Shelly
town_saltspray_shelly.bio: Sells maps, all of which lead to her shop.

town_wildwood_bark.name: Bark
town_wildwood_bark.bio: Trail guide who always gets lost on purpose.

town_wildwood_bluebell.name: Bluebell
town_wildwood_bluebell.bio: Grows carrots so big they need ladders.

town_wildwood_fennel_fox.name: Fennel Fox
town_wildwood_fennel_fox.bio: Berry pie baker. Pies are mostly berries, some pie.

town_wildwood_gran_grizzle.name: Gran Grizzle
town_wildwood_gran_grizzle.bio: Feeds the whole village. Feeds the owls too, despite the sign.

town_wildwood_hazel_hollow.name: Hazel Hollow
town_wildwood_hazel_hollow.bio: Runs the Acorn Exchange. Hoards the best acorns.

town_wildwood_moss.name: Moss
town_wildwood_moss.bio: Lumen gardener. Moves one plant per day.

town_wildwood_old_oakley.name: Old Oakley
town_wildwood_old_oakley.bio: Librarian of the Great Tree. Shushes the wind.

town_wildwood_pipkin.name: Pipkin
town_wildwood_pipkin.bio: Mushroom farmer, accidentally prickly with customers.

town_wildwood_twig.name: Twig
town_wildwood_twig.bio: Map maker. All maps are very, very small.

umbral_eclipse_leader.name: The Eclipse
umbral_eclipse_leader.bio: Leader of the Umbral Court. Hates sunny days, sunny people, sunflowers.

villain_dj_glitch_henchman_2.name: Glitch's Henchman 2
villain_dj_glitch_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_dr_drizzle_henchman_2.name: Drizzle's Henchman 2
villain_dr_drizzle_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_gloomcap_henchman_2.name: Gloomcap's Henchman 2
villain_gloomcap_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_madame_smog_henchman_2.name: Smog's Henchman 2
villain_madame_smog_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_moleculous_henchman_2.name: Moleculous's Henchman 2
villain_moleculous_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_quakeboar_henchman_2.name: Quakeboar's Henchman 2
villain_quakeboar_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_queen_frostbill_henchman_2.name: Frostbill's Henchman 2
villain_queen_frostbill_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".

villain_the_rust_baron_henchman_2.name: Baron's Henchman 2
villain_the_rust_baron_henchman_2.bio: Thinks the boss is "a bit much".
